literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe tags placed at the AQP7 N-terminus ('in front of the first ATG', 'at the N-terminus'). Per the authoritative topology landmarks, AQP7 residues 1–40 are INTRACELLULAR; the N-terminus is cytoplasmic, as is standard for aquaporins. A tag prepended before residue 1 (insert_after_residue=0) therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. L3 describes the G264V point mutant carrying the same N-terminal c-Myc tag and confirms surface trafficking of the protein, but G264 falls within TM6 (residues 253–276) and is a mutagenesis position, not a tag-insertion site. No ledger line grounds any insertion in ECL1 (60–67), ECL2 (134–167), ECL3 (221–252), or any other extracellular region of AQP7. The correct answer is zero extracellular surface sites.

literature_other_positions.note: c-Myc epitope inserted 'in front of the first ATG' (N-terminal prepend, before residue 1); the AQP7 N-terminus (residues 1–40) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. Tolerated for trafficking studies but not an extracellular surface tag.
